fusions.name: Maple Key
fusions.desc: Throws a winged seed that glides to its target and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles.

fusions.name: Covey Rising
fusions.desc: A flock bursts out of your crown and deals 11 wind damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: High Perch
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Windborne Seed
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you take root in new ground and regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
